\begin{example} \end{example}[flat manifolds have norm zero]

Source: petersen:page-0427 ↗ def:pet-ch11-cmalpha-norm-global 1. ch11:11.3.1A complete flat manifold satisfies $\| (M,g)\| _{C^{m,\alpha },r}=0$ for all $r\le \inj (M,g)$; in particular $\| (\mathbb {R}^n,g_{\mathrm{eu}})\| _{C^{m,\alpha },r}=0$ for all $r$. \end{example}
